customer_reply: To resolve error E-2207, please regenerate the integration credential: 1) Open **Admin > Integrations > Credentials**; 2) Click **Regenerate** for the credential used by your e‑signature integration and update the credential in the connected system; 3) Trigger a manual sync and verify the job status shows **Completed**. If the signature requests are still rejected, reply with the tenant ID and the IDs of the affected contracts so we can investigate further.
